chunks: Humayd ibn Ziyad from al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama'ah from Abdullah ibn Jabala from Is'haq ibn 'Ammar from Abu Baseer who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying regarding six brothers and a grandfather: He said: For the grandfather is the seventh.
ai.seo_question: What is the inheritance share of a grandfather when inheriting with six brothers?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the specific share of the paternal grandfather (al-jadd) as one-seventh when competing with six full brothers, a ruling derived from the principle of 'blocking' (hajb) where the grandfather is excluded from the 'Asaba' (residuary) category in favor of a fixed portion. This narration is pivotal in Shia jurisprudence for resolving the dispute between the 'one-sixth' and 'one-seventh' schools of thought regarding the grandfather's status relative to full siblings.

en.hubeali: Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Al Hassan Bin Muhammad Bin Sama’at, from Abdullah Bin Jabala, from Is’haq Bin Ammar, from Abu Baseer who said,
‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying regarding six brothers and a grandfather. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘For the grandfather is the seventh’.
en.sarwar: 5. Humayd ibn Ziyad has narrated from al-Hassan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama‘ah, from ‘Abd Allah ibn Jabalah from Ishaq ibn ‘Ammar from abu Basir who has narrated the following: “I once heard abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, saying about six brothers and a grandfather, ‘The grandfather is the seventh.’”
